# `IdentitySourceInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge\IdentitySourceInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge`](/packages/rbac-bridge) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-rbac-bridge/blob/master/src/IdentitySourceInterface.php)

Where the current user id comes from. In an HTTP deployment the shipped
CurrentUserIdentitySource adapter reads yiisoft/user's CurrentUser
(populated by the authentication middleware — under FPM one HTTP request
is one tool call, so "current" is exact). For stdio or custom setups
implement this with an env-/config-driven source.
